tep_prediction: Group Halo Screening suppresses Gamma_t in dense environments. rho(dust, Gamma_t) should be significantly lower in overdense regions than in the field, even after controlling for stellar mass.
method: Fisher Z-test for independent correlations comparing field vs overdense Spearman rho(dust, Gamma_t). Mass-matched quintile test controls for mass confounding. Partial correlation controls for both mass and environment.

full_sample.label: Full sample (z=4-10)

clustercentric_control.note: A2744 is a foreground cluster (z=0.308): d_A2744 is a systematics coordinate (lensing magnification + mosaic depth), not an ambient-field coordinate for the high-z sample. If the field-vs-dense contrast flips or vanishes within fixed d_A2744 terciles, the pooled contrast is a Simpson composition effect of the radial coordinate, not an environmental detection.

full_sample.tep_prediction: rho_field > rho_dense (screening suppresses in dense regions)
full_sample.interpretation: Consistent with TEP screening (delta_rho = +0.205, Z = 5.15, p = 0.0000)
